latestPost.text: AI infrastructure is not so constrained by where data can travel, but rather where scalable power can be secured. In conversation with @SchneiderElec's Kevin Brown, CTO Nazar Khan explains TeraWulf’s advantage: energy-advantaged sites with secured power, paired with the expertise to build the connectivity and infrastructure required for large-scale compute. That combination is what makes $WULF's sites truly differentiated.
